label: 032.Mangrove_Cuckoo
summary: The Mangrove Cuckoo (Aves cuckoo) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits temperate and subtropical woodlands, grasslands, and wetlands, where its diet consists primarily of insects, seeds, grains, berries, and small invertebrates.
habitat: Temperate and subtropical woodlands, grasslands, and wetlands
diet: Insects, seeds, grains, berries, and small invertebrates
